transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

Honestly, Doctor, for the past month I've been feeling this absolutely incredible, overwhelming surge of energy where I'm just on top of the world, though I also get super irritated at the tiniest things! I have so much fire in me that I physically cannot sit still or rest, and I just feel this constant, intense need to keep moving!
During this high-energy month, have you experienced anything unusual, like hearing voices, seeing things others can't, or feeling like you have special powers?

Yes, actually! I've been hearing these whispering voices when I'm alone, and I keep seeing strange, glowing figures that nobody else can see. It's because I've finally realized I possess this extraordinary, special power and have a grand purpose to save everyone!
Have you ever experienced these voices or visions during times when your mood was completely stable and you weren't feeling this high energy?
No, never. Those voices and visions only show up when my energy is through the roof and my mood is this high, and they completely go away when I'm feeling stable.
